budget_items.what_was_recorded: The carpet project was awarded to Atkinson Carpet & Flooring for $43,790, funded in the FY22 capital plan at $50,000, with a surplus anticipated.
budget_items.quote: public safety carpet project was awarded to atkinson carpet & flooring for $43,790 and expected to be completed by march

budget_items.what_was_recorded: MIIA announced FY25 rate increases of 2.2% to 9.95% (average 6.6%); the town's estimate was lowered from 10% to a maximum of 6.6%, and 10% would have been $450,000.
budget_items.quote: member alonzo asked what the difference would be to the town and the town manager replied 10% would be $450,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The current aggregate-account rate is .11868/kw and the contract expires in November 2024; the broker expects lower downside market costs.
